queries: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS order_share FROM order_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(order_share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(s.order_share) AS average_share, AVG(s.order_share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.order_share > b.average_share;

WITH account_orders AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM account_orders), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share;

WITH account_orders AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM account_orders), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - value) AS average_amount_above_average FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE share > value;
